sections.title: Computational Color Vision
sections.description: Students in many areas of psychology and engineering are concerned in one way or another with color, and many areas of color vision is amenable to precise quantitative characterization.  This course will develop the core ideas of our current understanding of color  from a theoretical and computational point of view. Topics will likely include radiometry, transduction of light, thresholds, color matching, color spaces, color constancy, color appearance, color categorization, and the neural representation of color.  Theoretical and computational methods will likely include linear algebra, ideal observer analysis, statistical inference (Bayes rule), information theory, and modeling with neural networks. The course will also consider implementation of ideas in code.
